requisitionList.Title: Freight Brokerage Operations Specialist
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Freight Brokerage Operations Specialist serves as a critical link between customers, carrier partners, and internal sales teams, ensuring the seamless execution of freight shipments from pickup through delivery. They negotiate rates, coordinate transportation activities, support customer accounts, and drive high-quality service across assigned accounts. They develop strong relationships with customers and internal partners to proactively resolve issues and identify opportunities for account growth.

requisitionList.Title: Freight Handler- Part Time- 3rd Shift
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Forklift Operator is responsible for the safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, staging, scanning, and movement of freight. As certified forklift operators within the operation, they provide safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, movement, and documentation of cargo/freight within a multimodal transportation terminal, intermodal yard, warehouse, or dock environment, directly contributing to productivity, workflow coordination, and freight integrity. As the most experienced team members without direct reports, they often assist with mentoring, guiding, and onboarding new Material Handlers and solving complex operational problems on the floor.

requisitionList.Title: Dispatcher - Regional
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Dispatcher - Regional supports day‑to‑day freight coordination across local, regional, and national OTR, and linehaul operations by scheduling, assigning, and tracking shipments. They are responsible for dispatching and supporting both company-employed drivers and independent contractor drivers, ensuring accurate data entry, shipment visibility, and consistent communication. They monitor freight movement across multiple route types, proactively communicating updates and escalating service issues when needed. They play a critical role in maintaining on‑time freight movement, regulatory compliance, and a high level of driver and customer service.

requisitionList.Title: Customer Relations Specialist-logistics
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Customer Relations Specialist / Operations Agent provides advanced customer service, operational coordination, and administrative oversight to support complex shipment activity within a domestic freight forwarding / transportation terminal. Serving as a senior point of contact, they manage escalated customer needs, oversee end‑to‑end shipment coordination, and resolve service issues and improve operational outcomes. They are responsible for overseeing scheduling, shipment tracking and tracing, documentation accuracy, and core financial processes including billing, accounts receivable, and accounts payable support. Working closely with customers, carriers, drivers, and internal operations teams, they proactively identify risks, recommend solutions, and ensure service commitments are met.

requisitionList.Title: Export Coordinator - Ocean
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Export Coordinator - Ocean supports international ocean export operations by coordinating shipment activities and ensuring accurate execution of export processes. They assist with bookings, documentation, and shipment tracking while following established procedures and timelines. They work closely with shipping lines, customers, and internal teams to support vessel departures and documentation accuracy.

requisitionList.Title: Operations Supervisor - Ocean
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Operations Supervisor – Ocean Freight is responsible for leading daily ocean import and export operations to ensure compliant, efficient, and cost‑effective international freight movement. They supervise a team of ocean freight forwarding professionals while serving as a subject matter expert across FCL and LCL shipments, carrier coordination, documentation, and import/export customs processes. They partner closely with internal teams, steamship lines, customs brokers, drayage providers, and overseas offices to maintain high service levels. They play a key role in managing operational performance, meeting customer SLAs, and resolving complex shipment issues. This hands-on leader brings strong background in international ocean freight operations, and a continuous improvement mindset.

requisitionList.Title: Automotive Technician/ Mechanic
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Mechanic will play a critical role in ensuring the safety, reliability, and performance of our fleet and warehouse equipment within a multimodal transportation terminal, intermodal yard, or contract logistics site. They are responsible for inspecting, diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining tractor trailers, forklifts (all types), and a variety of material handling equipment (MHE). They support operational readiness and uptime by ensuring our transportation and warehouse operations have reliable equipment available when needed. The Mechanic will work closely with operations leadership and maintenance teams to prioritize work orders and uphold safety and compliance standards.

requisitionList.Title: Operations Supervisor
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Operations Supervisor is responsible for leading day-to-day activities across multimodal transportation, supply chain, and/or contract logistics operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and accurate execution of core service processes. This role provides direct leadership to frontline associates and is accountable for operational performance, safety, quality, and customer service within the assigned function, area, or shift. They drive productivity, adherence to standard work, and continuous improvement while supporting customer commitments and operational excellence goals. They play a critical role in problem-solving, process optimization, and issue resolution in fast-paced operational environments.

They ensure delivery of contractual obligations while driving operational excellence scalability, and sustained performance. They coach site leaders and frontline teams, execute operational strategies, and lead continuous improvement initiatives that drive productivity, quality, cost, and service outcomes. They build strong relationships with customers, employees, and internal partners to support stability, growth, and long-term value creation.

requisitionList.Title: Senior Sales Executive - Logistics and Transportation
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Senior Sales Executive is responsible for driving profitable revenue growth by developing new enterprise customer relationships and expanding existing accounts through consultative, solution‑based selling. They focus on understanding complex customer supply chains, identifying opportunities across the company’s full portfolio of solutions, and delivering measurable value to customers. They act as a trusted advisor to decision makers, partnering closely with Commercial teams, Operations, and internal stakeholders to deliver a seamless customer experience. This position requires strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to lead internal teams without direct authority. Success in this role is measured by revenue growth, customer retention, and long‑term account expansion. The role is highly visible and plays a critical part in the organization’s enterprise growth strategy.

requisitionList.Title: Regional Workplace Safety Manager
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Regional Workplace Safety Manager serves as the regional safety leader, partnering with operational leadership to foster a strong culture of safety, compliance, and continuous improvement across transportation terminals, warehouse facilities, and office environments throughout the assigned region. They are responsible for developing, implementing, and enhancing workplace safety programs designed to protect employees, drivers, contractors, visitors, and company assets. They provide expertise in transportation, occupational safety, and workplace compliance requirements, including FMCSA, DOT, OSHA, and other applicable federal, state, and local regulations. Working closely with leadership teams, this position identifies risks, implements proactive mitigation strategies, and drives safety initiatives that support operational excellence. They investigate incidents, analyze safety trends, and develop corrective actions that improve safety performance and reduce organizational risk.

requisitionList.Title: Facilities Security Systems Specialist
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Facilities Security Systems Specialist is responsible for the administration, optimization, and continuous improvement of the Company's physical security technology infrastructure across a nationwide network of facilities. They are the subject matter expert for access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, and related security technologies. They evaluate system performance, develop solutions to operational challenges, coordinate security technology initiatives, and recommend enhancements that support organizational security objectives. They collaborate with facility leaders, IT, and external service providers to ensure security systems are effective, compliant, and aligned with company standards.

requisitionList.Title: Safety Technician
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Fleet Safety Technician is responsible for the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, inspection, and repair of fleet safety and technology equipment across the company's tractors, trailers, and related fleet assets. They support critical safety systems including Electronic Logging Devices (ELDs), in-cab cameras, telematics devices, and other onboard technologies that promote regulatory compliance and operational efficiency. They perform hands-on equipment installations, diagnostics, inspections, and inventory management while maintaining accurate maintenance and equipment records. This position serves as a key resource for drivers, independent contractors, Fleet Safety, Maintenance, and other internal departments by providing technical support and professional customer service.

requisitionList.Title: Export Specialist - Air
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Export Specialist - Air manages international air export operations and ensures the successful execution of complex shipments across global networks. They plan routings, resolve service exceptions, and balance customer requirements with operational and financial considerations. They serve as a primary point of contact for customers, carriers, and overseas partners, owning shipment performance from initiation through departure. They play a critical role in supporting business objectives and maintaining strong customer and carrier relationships.

requisitionList.Title: Dispatcher - Load Planner 1st Shift
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: As the load planner, you will take responsibility for the planning and forecasting functions for selected markets.  Provide creative solutions to exceed customer expectations.  Assign loads based on customer requirements, driver availability and maximum profitability for assigned market.

requisitionList.Title: Material Handler 2
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Material Handler 2 is an experienced front-line role responsible for the safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, staging, scanning, and movement of freight. They provide safe, accurate, and efficient loading, unloading, movement, and documentation of freight within a multimodal transportation terminal, intermodal yard, warehouse, or dock environment, directly contributing to productivity, workflow coordination, and freight integrity. As an experienced team member, they assist with indirectly onboarding and mentoring new and less experienced Material Handlers.

requisitionList.Title: Customs Brokerage Coordinator
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Customs Brokerage Compliance Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring the compliant, timely, and accurate movement of multimodal bonded freight within our terminal network. They support customs brokerage activities for ground, air, ocean, and rail shipments, helping customers navigate complex regulatory requirements while maintaining operational excellence. They work closely with internal teams, carriers, customs officials, and clients to ensure all documentation is properly managed and that shipments meet customs requirements efficiently.
